metadata.scope: Pasta category purchase decisions across major US retail channels

Grocery.description: In-store grocery shoppers prioritize variety and shapes of pasta over other attributes.

Natural.description: Natural food stores attract shoppers focused on health-oriented pasta options.

Online.description: Online shoppers prioritize brand and convenience-related attributes.

Club.description: Club stores emphasize bulk buying, so price and package size are more critical.

Target.description: Target shoppers align with grocery preferences but with more emphasis on price.

Walmart.description: Walmart shoppers focus heavily on price and brand recognition.

NET.description: An aggregate view of all channels, showing the general trends across shopping behaviors.

Pasta Shape/Variety.definition: Different shapes of pasta, such as spaghetti, penne, fusilli, etc.
Pasta Shape/Variety.use_case: Highly appealing in visual advertising and in-store displays.

Pasta Type.definition: Categories of pasta like whole grain, gluten-free, or traditional.
Pasta Type.use_case: Targeted for health-conscious consumers or dietary preferences.

Price Tier.definition: The pricing category of the product, such as budget, mid-range, or premium.
Price Tier.use_case: Critical for promotional campaigns and price-sensitive shoppers.

Brand.definition: The specific pasta brand (e.g., Barilla, De Cecco).
Brand.use_case: Drives online and in-store trust and loyalty campaigns.

Package Size.use_case: Important for bulk shoppers or value-focused campaigns.

Package Type.definition: The style of the packaging, such as box or bag.
Package Type.use_case: Relevant for sustainability messaging or convenience-focused shoppers.

Pasta Color or Flavor.definition: Variations like spinach pasta, tricolor pasta, or flavored options.
Pasta Color or Flavor.use_case: Used to appeal to adventurous or niche shoppers.

Domestic vs Imported.definition: Whether the pasta is produced domestically or imported.
Domestic vs Imported.use_case: Useful for campaigns focusing on local pride or premium imported products.
